idea-plugin.name: Subway Coders
idea-plugin.description:
Subway Coders plays looping Subway Surfers-style gameplay (and Minecraft parkour/story, Temple Run and other "brain-rot" clips) in tool windows right inside your IDE — so your subconscious stays maximally engaged while the rest of you reads code.
  • Four independent players, one per screen edge (left / right / top / bottom)
  • Clips render with JCEF — a YouTube link plays as an embed, any other URL as a looping video
  • Config-driven categories (Subway Surfers, Temple Run, Minecraft Parkour/Story, and more); each holds several clips and "Shuffle" picks another
  • Paste any YouTube or direct video URL to play your own clip
  • Per-window category and sound, plus "open in browser" and a config editor

A parody/fun plugin. "Subway Surfers" is a trademark of SYBO Games — this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
